name: @tastehub/ckb

tools.name: explore
tools.description: Use this FIRST when asked about a file, directory, or module — returns structure, key symbols, and change hotspots in one call. Best starting point for 'what is this?' or 'what's in this directory?' questions. For questions about a specific symbol, use understand instead.

depth.description: Exploration thoroughness: shallow (quick overview), standard (balanced), deep (comprehensive)

focus.description: Aspect to emphasize: structure (symbols/types), dependencies (imports/exports), changes (hotspots/history)

target.description: File, directory, or module path to explore

tools.name: understand
tools.description: Use this when asked about a specific symbol — returns full context (definition, references, call graph, explanation) in one call. Ideal for 'what does X do?' or 'how is X used?' questions. For file/directory-level questions, use explore instead.

includeReferences.description: Include reference information grouped by file

query.description: Symbol name or ID to understand

tools.name: prepareChange
tools.description: Use this BEFORE making a code change — returns blast radius, affected tests, coupled files, and risk score. Essential before modifying, renaming, deleting, or moving code. More comprehensive than analyzeImpact (includes tests + coupling). For analyzing changes already made, use analyzeChange instead.

endLine.description: End line of extraction region (for extract operations)

format.description: Response format: 'full' (default) returns all details; 'compact' returns a token-efficient summary with top affected files and tests

startLine.description: Start line of extraction region (for extract operations)

target.description: Symbol ID or file path to analyze

targetPath.description: Destination path for move operations (required when changeType is 'move')

tools.name: batchGet
tools.description: Retrieve multiple symbols by ID in a single call. Max 50 symbols. With includeCounts, also returns referenceCount, callerCount, calleeCount per symbol.

includeCounts.description: Include referenceCount, callerCount, calleeCount per symbol (adds SCIP lookups per symbol)

symbolIds.description: Array of symbol IDs to retrieve (max 50)

tools.name: batchSearch
tools.description: Perform multiple symbol searches in a single call. Max 10 queries.

tools.name: searchSymbols
tools.description: Semantic code search returning symbol types, locations, and relationships—more accurate than text-based grep/find. Note: may not match class methods or record properties by bare name — use symbolExists for authoritative boolean lookups.

excludePatterns.description: Exclude symbols whose name contains any pattern (e.g., '#' for struct fields, '<anonymous>')

kinds.description: Optional list of symbol kinds to filter (e.g., 'class', 'function')

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

minComplexity.description: Minimum cyclomatic complexity. Applied after tree-sitter enrichment.

minLines.description: Minimum body line count (filters trivial getters). Applied after tree-sitter enrichment.

scope.description: Path prefix or module ID to limit search scope (e.g., 'src/services/', 'internal/query')

tools.name: symbolExists
tools.description: Boolean oracle for LLM grounding: answers whether a bare symbol name has any declaration in the index. Uses exact-match (not FTS ranking) so class methods and object-property declarations are found reliably. Returns exists, matches count, distinct kinds, and receiver names for methods/properties. Cheaper than searchSymbols — no locations, no ranking.

name.description: Bare symbol name to look up (e.g. "saveReport", "ENV_PATH")

scope.description: Optional file-path prefix to restrict search (e.g. "packages/server/src/")

tools.name: getSymbol
tools.description: Get symbol metadata and location by stable ID

repoStateMode.description: Whether to use HEAD commit only or full working tree state

tools.name: explainSymbol
tools.description: Get an AI-friendly explanation of a symbol including usage, history, and summary

symbolId.description: The stable symbol ID to explain

tools.name: explainFile
tools.description: Get lightweight orientation for a file including role, symbols, and key relationships

filePath.description: Path to the file (relative or absolute)

tools.name: explainPath
tools.description: Explain why a path exists and what role it plays. Returns role classification (core, glue, legacy, test-only, config, unknown) with reasoning.

tools.name: findReferences
tools.description: Find all references to a symbol with completeness information

limit.description: Maximum number of references to return

scope.description: Path prefix or module ID to limit search scope (e.g., 'src/services/', 'internal/query')

tools.name: getCallGraph
tools.description: Get a lightweight call graph showing callers and callees of a symbol

symbolId.description: The root symbol ID for the call graph

tools.name: traceUsage
tools.description: Trace how a symbol is reached from system entrypoints. Returns causal paths, not just neighbors.

maxPaths.description: Maximum number of paths to return

symbolId.description: The target symbol ID to trace usage for

tools.name: getArchitecture
tools.description: Get codebase architecture with module dependencies. For single-module projects, use granularity='directory' or 'file' for meaningful visualization.

includeMetrics.description: Include aggregate metrics (complexity, churn) per directory. Only applies to directory granularity.

inferModules.description: Infer modules from directory structure when no explicit package boundaries exist

targetPath.description: Optional path to focus on (relative to repo root)

tools.name: getModuleOverview
tools.description: Get a high-level overview of a module including size and recent activity

name.description: Optional friendly name for the module

tools.name: getModuleResponsibilities
tools.description: Get responsibilities for modules. Returns what each module does, its capabilities, and how confident we are in this assessment. Extracted from README files, doc comments, and code analysis.

limit.description: Maximum number of modules to return

moduleId.description: Specific module ID to get responsibilities for. Omit to get all modules.

tools.name: listKeyConcepts
tools.description: Discover main ideas/concepts in the codebase through semantic clustering. Helps understand domain vocabulary.

limit.description: Maximum number of concepts to return (max 12)

tools.name: analyzeImpact
tools.description: Use this to check 'what breaks if I change X?' — returns callers, affected modules, and risk score for a single symbol. For full pre-change analysis with tests and coupling, use prepareChange instead. For analyzing a git diff of changes already made, use analyzeChange.

depth.description: Maximum depth for transitive impact analysis

includeTelemetry.description: Include observed telemetry data in analysis (requires telemetry to be enabled)

symbolId.description: The stable symbol ID to analyze

telemetryPeriod.description: Time period for telemetry data (7d, 30d, 90d, all)

tools.name: getHotspots
tools.description: Find files that deserve attention based on churn, coupling, and recency. Highlights volatile areas that may need review.

limit.description: Maximum number of hotspots to return (max 50)

tools.name: exportForLLM
tools.description: Export codebase structure in LLM-friendly format. Includes symbols, complexity, usage, and ownership.

minCalls.description: Only include symbols with calls/day >= N

minComplexity.description: Only include symbols with complexity >= N

tools.name: getStatus
tools.description: Get CKB system status including backend health, cache stats, repository state, and usage hints for available capabilities.

tools.name: switchProject
tools.description: Switch CKB to a different project directory. Use this when CKB is indexed for the wrong project. Accepts any git repository path — it does not need to be pre-registered.

path.description: Absolute path to the project directory (must be a git repository with CKB initialized)

tools.name: planRefactor
tools.description: Plan a refactoring operation with combined risk assessment, impact analysis, test strategy, and ordered steps. Aggregates prepareChange + auditRisk + analyzeTestGaps into a single call.

target.description: File path or symbol ID to refactor

tools.name: expandToolset
tools.description:
Switch to a larger toolset for a specific workflow. Call this when you need tools not in the current set. Presets (each includes all core tools plus):
• review (40 tools): reviewPR, auditCompliance, scanSecrets, analyzeTestGaps, getAffectedTests, compareAPI, findDeadCode, findUnwiredModules, auditRisk, getOwnership — use for PR reviews, test coverage analysis, compliance audits, security
• refactor (33 tools): analyzeCoupling, findCycles, suggestRefactorings, findDeadCode, findUnwiredModules, compareAPI, explainOrigin — use for refactoring, dependency analysis, dead code removal
• federation (36 tools): federationSearch*, listContracts, analyzeContractImpact — use for multi-repo queries, cross-repo analysis
• docs (27 tools): indexDocs, getDocsForSymbol, checkDocStaleness, getDecisions, recordDecision — use for documentation, ADRs
• ops (33 tools): doctor, reindex, daemonStatus, listJobs, webhooks, telemetry — use for diagnostics, daemon management
• full (94 tools): everything — use when you need tools from multiple presets

preset.description: The preset to expand to. Pick the smallest preset that has the tools you need.

reason.description: Why you need this preset (required to prevent accidental expansion)
